title: 第9章 管事传唤暗藏试探第10章 暗藏机锋稳步潜修
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 午后暖阳斜照，洒落在青岚宗后山杂役院。
院落间人影往来，杂役弟子各司其职，清扫山道、收拾柴垛，一派井然有序的模样。
只是所有人行事之间，都下意识保持着几分拘谨。
自昨夜林宸以一敌五，强势震服赵虎一行人之后，整个杂役院的风气都悄然变了。
往日里抱团欺弱、寻衅滋事的现象少了大半。
没人再敢肆意横行，生怕一不小心，触碰到那位角落里的冷面少年。
林宸独自立在院落僻静处，身形挺拔，神色淡然。
他不急不缓，呼吸绵长，借着午后清幽气息，默默运转吐纳心法。
天地间稀薄的灵气，顺着周身毛孔缓缓渗入体内。
经过青纹灵草的药力淬炼，他的经脉早已拓宽数分，纳气效率远超从前。
再加上肉身深处寂灭道体的暗中加持，哪怕只是随意站立吐纳，修行进境也远胜普通杂役苦修整日。
他刻意压制突破境界的念头，始终固守炼气一层圆满根基。
不求速成，只愿把每一分灵力都凝练到极致，沉淀底蕴，不留下半点虚浮隐患。
周遭路过的杂役弟子，远远看到林宸的身影，全都放轻脚步，绕道而行。
没人敢上前搭话，也没人敢随意打量。
敬畏之心，已然在众人心底深深扎根。
林宸对此全然漠视。
旁人的态度，敬畏也好，疏远也罢，都动摇不了他的道心。
经历过修真界万千风浪，他早已看淡这些底层人情世故。
唯有自身实力稳步提升，才是立足世间唯一的根本。
就在他静心吐纳，稳固修为根基之时。
一阵沉稳的脚步声，带着几分威严，径直朝着这边走来。
来人身着灰黑色管事服饰，面容方正，眼神略带凌厉，周身隐隐有灵气流转，修为远超普通杂役弟子。
正是杂役院管事，王奎。
平日里掌管杂役院所有劳作分派、规矩惩戒，手握底层弟子的管束之权，性子势利，偏爱拿捏权势，看人下菜碟。
王奎身后跟着两名杂役随从，步伐沉稳，神情肃穆，带着几分公事公办的架势。
院落里正在劳作的弟子，看到王奎走来，全都瞬间收敛言谈，低头躬身，不敢多言。
整个杂役院，没人敢在管事面前有半分放肆。
王奎目光扫视院落一圈，最终定格在静立一旁的林宸身上。
眼神带着几分审视与探究，径直迈步朝着林宸走去。
周遭弟子见状，纷纷停下手中活计，眼角余光悄悄留意这边动静，心底暗自好奇。
谁都清楚，王奎向来很少主动过问底层杂役琐事。
如今特意来找林宸，多半是为了昨夜赵虎等人被打的事情。
不少人心中暗忖，这下林宸怕是要惹上麻烦了。
赵虎平日里素来懂得巴结管事，私下时常孝敬下品灵石，深得王奎几分偏袒。
昨夜林宸当众重创赵虎五人，以王奎的性子，必然不会坐视不理。
content_en:
The warm afternoon sun shone slantingly on the Qinglan Sect's back mountain miscellaneous courtyard.
There were people coming and going in the courtyard, and the handyman disciples were performing their duties, cleaning the mountain paths and collecting firewood piles, showing an orderly appearance.
It's just that everyone is subconsciously cautious in their actions.
Ever since Lin Chen defeated Zhao Hu and his entourage last night with one against five, the atmosphere in the entire courtyard has quietly changed.
In the past, the phenomenon of teaming up to bully others, picking fights and provoking troubles has been mostly reduced.
No one dared to act recklessly anymore, for fear of accidentally touching the cold-faced young man in the corner.
Lin Chen stood alone in a secluded place in the courtyard, tall and straight, with a calm expression.
He was neither hasty nor slow, breathing long and long, using the quiet afternoon breath to silently circulate and exhale his inner thoughts.
The thin spiritual energy between heaven and earth slowly seeps into the body along the pores of the whole body.
After tempering with the medicinal power of the green-grained spiritual grass, his meridians have been widened by several points, and the efficiency of absorbing qi is far higher than before.
Coupled with the secret blessing of the Nirvana Taoist body deep in the physical body, even if you just stand and breathe out at will, your progress in practice will be far better than that of an ordinary handyman practicing hard for a whole day.
He deliberately suppressed the idea of ​​breaking through the realm and always adhered to the foundation of perfect Qi refining.
I don’t seek quick results, I just want to condense every ounce of spiritual power to the extreme, accumulate the foundation, and leave no hidden dangers.
When the handyman disciples passing by saw Lin Chen's figure from a distance, they all stepped lightly and took a detour.
No one dared to come up to talk to him, and no one dared to look at him casually.
The feeling of awe has been deeply rooted in everyone's hearts.
Lin Chen completely ignored this.
The attitude of others, be it awe or alienation, could not shake his Taoist heart.
After experiencing thousands of storms in the world of cultivation, he has long looked down on the human world and sophistication of these low-level people.
Only the steady improvement of one's own strength is the only foundation for standing in the world.
Just when he calmly breathed out and consolidated the foundation of his cultivation.
There was a steady sound of footsteps, with a bit of majesty, walking straight towards this direction.
The person who came was wearing gray and black steward uniforms, with a square face and slightly sharp eyes. There was faint spiritual energy flowing around his body, and his cultivation level was far beyond that of ordinary handyman disciples.
It was Wang Kui, the steward of the Miscellaneous Service Court.
On weekdays, he is in charge of all work assignments, rules and punishments in the courtyard, and has the power to control the lower-level disciples. He has a snobbish temperament and prefers to manipulate power and see what others do.
Wang Kui was followed by two servants, their steps were steady, their expressions were solemn, and they had a somewhat business-like attitude.
When the disciples who were working in the courtyard saw Wang Kui approaching, they all immediately stopped talking, bowed their heads, and did not dare to say anything.
In the entire courtyard, no one dared to act impudently in front of the stewards.
Wang Kui glanced around the courtyard and finally settled on Lin Chen, who was standing quietly beside him.
With a bit of scrutiny and inquiry in his eyes, he walked straight towards Lin Chen.
Upon seeing this, the surrounding disciples stopped what they were doing and quietly noticed the movement from the corner of their eyes, secretly curious in their hearts.
Everyone knows that Wang Kui rarely takes the initiative to ask about the trivial matters of low-level servants.
Now he came to Lin Chen specifically because of what happened last night when Zhao Hu and others were beaten.
Many people were secretly thinking that Lin Chen might be in trouble now.
Zhao Hu always knew how to curry favor with others and often showed respect to low-grade spiritual stones in private, which earned Wang Kui some favoritism.
Last night, Lin Chen severely injured Zhao Hu and the other five people in public. With Wang Kui's temperament, he would definitely not sit idly by.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Steward Summons and Hidden Temptation Chapter 10 Hidden Opportunities and Steady Cultivation
